questions.q: C ko middle-level language kyun kehte hain?
questions.a: High-level syntax aur low-level memory access (pointers, bitwise ops) dono deta hai, isliye OS aur embedded dono me use hota hai.
questions.followUp: Hardware ke sabse kareeb cheez? — pointers aur volatile.

questions.a: Compiler pehle poora machine code banata hai, interpreter line-by-line chalta hai. C me errors runtime se pehle milte hain aur execution fast hoti hai.
questions.followUp: C runtime error example? — divide by zero, null dereference.

questions.q: main() ka return value kahan jaata hai?
questions.a: OS ko exit status ke roop me: 0 success, non-zero failure. Shell me echo $? se dikhta hai.
questions.followUp: EXIT_SUCCESS kahan hai? — stdlib.h.

questions.q: Preprocessor compiler se alag kaise hai?
questions.a: Preprocessor text-level kaam karta hai: includes paste, macros replace, conditional blocks. Uske baad compiler grammar parse karta hai.
questions.followUp: Kaunsa flag sirf preprocess karta hai? — -E.

questions.q: Object file aur executable me fark?
questions.a: Object me compiled code + unresolved symbols ho sakte hain; executable me linker ne sab resolve kar diya hota hai.
questions.followUp: Static library kya hai? — .o files ka archive (.a).

questions.a: Out-of-bounds, use-after-free, double free, leaks — detailed runtime report ke saath.
questions.followUp: UBSan? — signed overflow, invalid shift jaise UB.

questions.q: float aur double me kya chuno?
questions.a: float 4 bytes ~7 significant digits, double 8 bytes ~15. Default double lo; float sirf memory-critical arrays me jab precision kaafi ho.
questions.followUp: long double? — extended precision, platform-dependent.

questions.a: Lifetime poore program ki hoti hai par scope block tak seemit; function calls ke beech value retain hoti hai (e.g. call counter). Thread-safe nahi.
questions.followUp: static global ka matlab? — internal linkage, sirf usi translation unit me dikhta hai.

questions.a: Jab aap jaan-bujh kar conversion chahte ho (double→int truncation, void*→typed pointer) ya warning suppress karni ho. Implicit conversion par bharosa mat karo.
questions.followUp: Casting pointer ka risk? — galat type par dereference UB.

questions.q: scanf aur fgets me kya safe hai?
questions.a: fgets buffer size leta hai, isliye overflow nahi hota; scanf %s unbounded hai jab tak width na do (%31s). Line input ke liye fgets better hai.
questions.followUp: fgets newline? — include karta hai, trim karo.

questions.a: Undefined behaviour: galat bytes padhe jaate hain, garbage ya crash. Compiler -Wformat warning deta hai.
questions.followUp: printf("%d", 3.5) kyun galat? — double varargs me double hi jaata hai, %d int expect karta hai.

questions.a: stdout buffered hai (line ya full), stderr unbuffered — errors turant dikhte hain aur redirection se alag file me ja sakte hain.
questions.followUp: perror kahan likhta hai? — stderr.

questions.a: Null check ke saath dereference: if (p != NULL && p->value > 0) — pehla false ho to dereference hi nahi hota. Isi tarah divide-by-zero guard.
questions.followUp: Bitwise & se kyun nahi? — wo dono sides evaluate karta hai.

questions.q: Signed overflow aur unsigned overflow me fark?
questions.a: Signed overflow undefined behaviour hai (compiler assume kar sakta hai kabhi nahi hoga); unsigned arithmetic modulo 2^N wrap karti hai, defined hai.
questions.followUp: Overflow detect kaise? — __builtin_add_overflow ya wider type.

questions.q: Precedence table yaad rakhna zaroori hai?
questions.a: Core order yaad rakho (unary → multiplicative → additive → shift → relational → equality → bitwise → logical → conditional → assignment) aur baaki brackets se clear karo — galat precedence silent bug deta hai.
questions.followUp: a & b == 0 ka matlab? — == pehle chalta hai, isliye a & (b==0).

questions.q: if-else aur switch me kab kya?
questions.a: Discrete integral values (menu, state) ke liye switch readable hai aur compiler jump table bana sakta hai. Ranges, floats aur complex conditions ke liye if-else.
questions.followUp: switch me string? — C me nahi; if/strcmp use karo.

questions.a: Bina braces ke else nearest unmatched if se judta hai, jo expected se alag ho sakta hai. Braces se ambiguity khatam karo.
questions.followUp: Compiler warning? — -Wdangling-else.

questions.a: Jab multiple case labels ek hi code chalaते hain (case 3: case 4: ...). Warna break bhoolna bug hai; /* fallthrough */ comment likho.
questions.followUp: Kaunsa warning help karta hai? — -Wimplicit-fallthrough.

questions.q: for aur while me kab kya?
questions.a: Jab iterations ki count pata ho to for; jab condition data-driven ho (EOF tak, sentinel tak) to while. Dono equivalent hain — readability decide karti hai.
questions.followUp: do-while ka best use? — menu jise kam se kam ek baar dikhana hai.

questions.q: Loop me array ka size har baar calculate karna kyun bura hai?
questions.a: strlen O(n) hai; loop condition me call karne se total O(n^2). Ek baar len nikal lo. Compiler kuch cases optimize karta hai par bharosa mat karo.
questions.followUp: size_t loop ke saath warning? — signed/unsigned comparison warning; size_t use karo.

questions.q: Infinite loop ko intentionally kaise likhte hain?
questions.a: for (;;) ya while (1) with a break. Embedded/event loops aise likhe jaate hain; exit condition clear honi chahiye.
questions.followUp: Compiler warning? — -Wunreachable-code se baad ka code pakda ja sakta hai.

questions.q: Pattern program ka logic kaise todte ho?
questions.a: Row count nikalo, har row ke liye spaces aur characters ka formula likho, phir nested loops me wahi formula daalo. Dry run se verify karo.
questions.followUp: Hollow pattern ka trick? — border condition.

questions.q: Patterns ka real use kya hai (sirf interview)?
questions.a: Nested loop aur coordinate thinking sikhate hain jo matrices, image processing aur canvas rendering me same tarah use hoti hai.
questions.followUp: Matrix printing? — same i/j loops.

questions.q: Function overloading C me kyun nahi hai?
questions.a: C me name mangling nahi hoti; linker ke liye function ka naam hi identity hai. Same naam ke do functions duplicate symbol dete hain. C++ me mangling se overloading possible hai.
questions.followUp: C me alternative? — alag naam ya _Generic macro.

questions.q: Array function me pass karne par size kyun nahi aata?
questions.a: Array parameter pointer me decay hota hai, isliye sizeof pointer ka size deta hai. Size alag parameter me bhejo.
questions.followUp: 2D array? — columns ki width parameter me chahiye.

questions.a: Runtime par behaviour choose karna (callbacks, qsort comparator, menu dispatch). Syntax: int (*fp)(int,int) = add; fp(2,3).
questions.followUp: qsort comparator signature? — int (*)(const void*, const void*).

questions.a: Recursive call function ka last operation ho aur result par koi kaam na bache. Kuch compilers ise loop me badal dete hain, par C standard guarantee nahi deta.
questions.followUp: C me guaranteed? — nahi, manually loop likho.

questions.a: Naive recursion same subproblems dobara solve karta hai — O(2^n). Memo array se O(n) time, O(n) space.
questions.followUp: Bottom-up? — iterative DP O(1) space.

questions.a: Nahi. Array ek object hai jiska size hota hai; expression me wo pehle element ke pointer me decay hota hai. sizeof array total bytes deta hai, sizeof pointer 8.
questions.followUp: Array assign? — nahi, copy ke liye memcpy/loop.

questions.a: Variable Length Array (C99): runtime size wala local array, e.g. int a[n]. C11 me optional hai; stack par banta hai — bada n stack overflow de sakta hai.
questions.followUp: Portable alternative? — malloc/free.

questions.a: Original string modify karta hai, static state rakhta hai (thread-safe nahi), aur consecutive delimiters handle karta hai. Reentrant version strtok_r hai.
questions.followUp: strtok_r signature? — strtok_r(s, delim, &saveptr).

questions.a: Agar source length n se badi ho to null terminator copy nahi hota; agar chhoti ho to baaki buffer null se bhar deta hai (performance). Manually terminate karo ya snprintf lo.
questions.followUp: Best? — snprintf with size.

questions.a: Wo pointer jo already free ho chuki ya scope se bahar gayi memory ko point karta hai. Dereference UB hai. Free ke baad NULL set karo.
questions.followUp: Detect? — ASan use-after-free report deta hai.

questions.a: const int *p: value read-only, pointer badal sakte ho. int *const p: pointer fix, value badal sakte ho. const int *const p: dono.
questions.followUp: Declaration kaise padhein? — right to left.

questions.a: a[i] == *(a+i) expression me, par array object nahi hai pointer: sizeof aur assignment alag behave karte hain.
questions.followUp: Pass by array? — C me sirf pointer pass hota hai.

questions.a: int cmp(const void *a, const void *b) { int x=*(const int*)a, y=*(const int*)b; return (x>y)-(x<y); }
questions.followUp: Descending? — return ulta karo.

questions.a: CPU aligned access fast karta hai; compiler members ko unke alignment par rakhta hai, beech me gaps chhodta hai. sizeof isliye sum se bada hota hai.
questions.followUp: Padding kam kaise? — members ko size ke descending order me rakho.

questions.q: Struct by value pass karna kab bura?
questions.a: Bade struct ki copy expensive hoti hai aur function original modify nahi kar sakta. const pointer bhejo.
questions.followUp: Return by value? — compiler often optimize karta hai (RVO).

questions.q: Memory leak production me kaise pakdein?
questions.a: ASan/Valgrind se development me, heap profiler se production me, aur ownership review se. Har malloc ka ek clear free path hona chahiye.
questions.followUp: Valgrind command? — valgrind --leak-check=full ./app

questions.q: realloc fail hone par kya hota hai?
questions.a: NULL return karta hai aur original block valid rehta hai. Isliye result tmp me lo, warna original pointer kho kar leak ho jaata hai.
questions.followUp: Size 0? — implementation-defined; free jaisa treat karo.

questions.q: Text aur binary mode ka fark?
questions.a: Text mode newline translation kar sakta hai (Windows CRLF) aur Ctrl-Z ko EOF samajh sakta hai; binary mode raw bytes deta hai. Binary records ke liye "b" use karo.
questions.followUp: Portable records? — fixed-width types, endianness document karo.

questions.a: Buffered data flush hota hai, file descriptor free hota hai, aur write errors report hote hain. Leak se descriptors khatam ho jaate hain.
questions.followUp: Crash par buffer? — data lose ho sakta hai; fflush ya atomic rename.

questions.a: Macro text replace karta hai (type-agnostic, no scope, double evaluation risk); inline function type-checked hai aur debugger me dikhta hai. Default inline lo, macro sirf token pasting/#if ke liye.
questions.followUp: # stringize? — #x, ## concatenation.

questions.a: Optimized binary debug symbols ke saath build hota hai; par optimized variables 'optimized out' ho sakte hain, isliye debugging ke liye -O0/-Og better.
questions.followUp: Release strip? — strip binary se symbols hataata hai.

questions.a: Pivot hamesha smallest/largest ho (already sorted array with first/last pivot) to partitions unbalanced ho jaate hain — O(n^2). Random pivot ya median-of-three se avoid.
questions.followUp: Space? — average O(log n) recursion stack.

questions.q: Hash map se two-sum O(n) kaise?
questions.a: Ek pass me har element ke liye target - x dekho map me; mila to pair, warna x ko index ke saath store karo. Average O(n), O(n) space.
questions.followUp: Sorted array? — two pointers O(1) space.

questions.q: Linked list kab array se better?
questions.a: Jab frequent insert/delete head/middle par ho aur random access ki zaroorat na ho; size dynamic ho. Array cache-friendly aur O(1) indexing deta hai.
questions.followUp: Real use? — LRU cache, adjacency list, undo.

questions.a: Chaining (same bucket me linked list) ya open addressing (linear/quadratic probing, double hashing). Load factor threshold par resize.
questions.followUp: Worst case? — O(n); balanced tree buckets se O(log n).

questions.q: Why is C called a compiled language?
questions.a: The whole source is translated to machine code before it runs, so errors surface at compile time and execution is fast.
It pastes the declarations of standard I/O functions (printf, scanf, FILE) so the compiler knows their signatures.
Declaration announces a type/signature; definition allocates storage or provides the body. A variable can be declared many times, defined once.

questions.q: What is the entry point of a C program?
questions.a: main(). Execution starts there; its return value becomes the process exit status.

questions.q: Why does sizeof(int) differ across platforms?
questions.a: The C standard only guarantees minimum ranges, not exact widths. Use sizeof and <stdint.h> for portability.
A result outside the type's range. Signed overflow is undefined behaviour; unsigned wraps modulo 2^N and is defined.
Binary floating point cannot represent 0.1/0.2 exactly, so the sum is slightly off. Compare with an epsilon.

questions.q: Why does scanf need & before an int?
questions.a: scanf must write into the variable, so it needs the address. Arrays already decay to an address, so no & for %s.

questions.q: Why is fgets safer than scanf("%s")?
questions.a: fgets takes a buffer size and cannot overflow; bare %s has no bound and can write past the array.
&& and || stop evaluating once the result is known, which lets you guard a dereference or a division.
Prefix increments then yields the new value; postfix yields the old value then increments.

questions.q: Why prefer braces around if bodies?
questions.a: Without braces a second statement silently falls outside the condition, and the dangling else binds to the nearest if.

questions.q: When is switch better than if-else?
questions.a: For discrete integral values (menu, state). Ranges and complex conditions need if-else.
while tests before the body (may run zero times); do-while tests after (runs at least once).

questions.q: How do you avoid an infinite loop?
questions.a: Guarantee progress inside the body (update the loop variable) and make the exit condition reachable.

questions.q: Why pass a struct by pointer?
questions.a: To avoid copying and to let the callee modify the original. Use const pointer when only reading.

questions.q: What is a function prototype for?
questions.a: It tells the compiler the signature before the call, enabling type checking and preventing implicit declarations.
Not directly. Return a struct or use pointer out-parameters.

questions.q: When does recursion overflow the stack?
questions.a: When depth grows without a reachable base case, or the depth exceeds the thread's stack (large n).
It recomputes the same subproblems, giving O(2^n). Memoization or iteration reduces it to O(n).

questions.q: Why doesn't sizeof give the array size inside a function?
questions.a: The array parameter decays to a pointer, so sizeof returns the pointer's size. Pass the length separately.

questions.q: How is a 2D array laid out?
questions.a: Row-major: all columns of row 0, then row 1. Address = base + (i*cols + j)*element_size.

questions.q: Why must a string have a null terminator?
questions.a: Library functions (strlen, %s) stop at '�'; without it they read past the buffer.

questions.q: Why is strncpy easy to misuse?
questions.a: It does not null-terminate when the source is too long, and pads with zeros when shorter. Set the terminator yourself or use snprintf.
0 if equal, negative if the first is lexicographically smaller, positive if greater.
A pointer to memory that was freed or went out of scope. Dereferencing it is undefined behaviour.

questions.q: What does pointer arithmetic p+1 mean?
questions.a: It advances by one element (sizeof *p bytes), not one byte.

questions.q: Difference between const int *p and int *const p?
questions.a: The first makes the pointee read-only; the second makes the pointer itself read-only.

questions.q: What is a void pointer used for?
questions.a: A generic address holder (malloc, callbacks). It cannot be dereferenced or used in arithmetic without a cast.

questions.q: Why does sizeof(struct) exceed the sum of members?
questions.a: Padding and alignment: the compiler inserts gaps so each member sits at a proper boundary.
A struct stores every member separately; a union shares one storage area, so only one member is valid at a time.

questions.q: Why check the return value of fopen?
questions.a: It returns NULL on failure (missing file, permissions), and using NULL crashes.
"w" truncates or creates; "a" appends without destroying existing content.
malloc returns uninitialized bytes; calloc zeroes them and takes count and size.
It returns NULL and the original block stays valid — assign to a temporary or you leak it.
Calling free twice on the same pointer. It corrupts the allocator and is undefined behaviour.

questions.q: How do you detect memory leaks?
questions.a: AddressSanitizer or Valgrind in development, heap profilers in production, plus explicit ownership rules.
On the stack, with automatic lifetime tied to the block. Large or runtime-sized data belongs on the heap.

questions.q: What is a function pointer good for?
questions.a: Runtime dispatch and callbacks — qsort comparators, menu tables, event handlers.

questions.q: Why can two pointers not be meaningfully compared across arrays?
questions.a: Only pointers into the same array object (plus one past the end) have defined ordering; anything else is unspecified.
Text substitution ignores scope and types, can double-evaluate arguments, and produces confusing errors. Prefer inline functions.
#ifndef/#define/#endif around a header so multiple includes do not redefine its contents.

questions.q: How do you build a multi-file project?
questions.a: Compile each .c to .o, then link: gcc main.c util.c -o app. Keep declarations in headers.

questions.q: Why is binary search O(log n)?
questions.a: Each comparison halves the remaining range, so the number of steps is logarithmic.
Merge sort, insertion sort, bubble sort (with strict comparison). Quick sort and selection sort are not stable by default.

questions.q: When does quick sort degrade to O(n^2)?
questions.a: When partitions are extremely unbalanced, e.g. always picking the first element of a sorted array as pivot.
Walking two indices from ends or in the same direction to solve pair/window problems in O(n) on sorted or monotonic data.
Array gives O(1) indexing but O(n) insert/delete; a linked list gives O(1) insert/delete at a known node but O(n) access.

questions.q: How do you detect a cycle in a linked list?
questions.a: Floyd's tortoise and hare: slow moves one node, fast two; they meet if a cycle exists.
Stack is LIFO (push/pop at top); queue is FIFO (enqueue at rear, dequeue at front).

questions.q: Why is a hash table average O(1)?
questions.a: The hash function maps a key directly to a bucket; with a low load factor collisions are rare.

questions.q: What is the worst case for a BST?
questions.a: A skewed tree behaves like a linked list, so search becomes O(n). Balanced trees guarantee O(log n).

questions.q: What does a segmentation fault mean?
questions.a: The process accessed memory it does not own — NULL dereference, freed memory, or out-of-bounds access.
It instruments memory accesses and reports the exact line for overflow, use-after-free, double free and leaks.
Code the standard places no requirements on — signed overflow, out-of-bounds, uninitialized reads. The compiler may do anything.
Enables a large set of useful compiler warnings; -Werror turns them into errors so they cannot be ignored.

questions.q: What is the difference between -c and linking?
questions.a: -c compiles and assembles to an object file; linking resolves symbols and combines objects and libraries into an executable.
Array subscripting is defined as pointer arithmetic on the decayed pointer; both forms are equivalent expressions.
No. A string literal is read-only; modifying it is undefined behaviour. Use `char s[] = "hi";`.
